name: Modal 002
description: Modal 002 hybrid synthesizer (keyboard): every controller of its manual's MIDI CC implementation chart, with the values it prints.

sources.title: MODAL 002 User Manual v1.03
sources.notes: MIDI CC implementation chart (pages 47, 48, 49 of the PDF) read by tools/profiles/modal/import-modal.mjs from MODAL002_MANUAL_v1-03.pdf (sha256 b1103cb77a783e7475115a1c6dc5185d94cc55251a0a86d5f70cce6a15e30e67), https://modalelectronics.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/MODAL002_MANUAL_v1-03.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/modal/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/modal/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI CC implementation chart, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The chart prints each controller's values: a range is the parameter's, bands and named values a choice (a band's first value sent), anything else 0 - 127 with the printed text in the description.
Left out, the wheel, the pedals, the joystick, bank select, the NRPN controllers and the channel mode messages: CC 1 Mod Wheel, CC 64 Sustain.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow
